ModMetaData.name: Misc. Craftable Robots
ModMetaData.author: leion247
ModMetaData.description: Adds recipes for the robots in Misc. Robots mod made by Haplo_X1. Along with adding five new robots that can also be crafted. NEW: (2/4/2025) Additional mod settings have been added when using the XML Extensions mod. More Below. Helpful Mods: These are highly recommended mods that enchance the experience of this mod. Check them out with a link to them in the mod description on the workshop page or find them directly by name. -Misc. Craftable Robots Addon -Misc. Craftable Robots Retexture -Misc. Craftable Robots 简繁汉化 (Chinese Localization) -Misc. Robots Worktab Support Crafting Recipes: Construction, Crafting, Gardener, Mining, and Med bot recipe costs: (1.0 and up) Steel - 150 Plasteel - 30 Gold - 8 (80) Component - 5 Advanced Component - 1~3 Crafting Recipes: Construction, Crafting, Gardener, Mining, Cleaning, and Hauling bot recipe costs: (0.19 and below) Steel - 250 Component - 10 Mod load order: Core (R) XML Extensions Misc. Core Misc. (anything else Misc. related) Misc. Robots (R) Misc. Craftable Robots (R) Misc. (helpful mods) [FSF] Complex Jobs Notice: (R) = Required Helpful Mods Recommended Order: Misc. Craftable Robots Addon (Continued) Misc. Craftable Robots Retexture Misc. Craftable Robots 简繁汉化 Misc. Robots Worktab Support Patches: This mod has patches to ensure compatibility with the following mods. -Quarry (1.0 and up) -Allow Tool (1.0 and up) -[FSF] Complex Jobs (Full patch for 1.0-1.4. Complementary patch for 1.5 with mod.) Other mods have patches to ensure compatibility with this mod. -[FSF] Complex Jobs (1.5 only) Notice: Adding any of these to an existing game with existing bots will require replacing said bots to get the new worktypes. Notice: Changing your mod order can remove the patched worktypes from existing bots in an existing save. Making them unable to do those worktypes. Replace them with new bots, which will have the expected worktypes. Mod Settings: If you have XML Extensions, you'll have access to a new mod settings menu to change the level of all your bots. Bot speed, hauler carrying capacity, and other traits are also available. Bot stations have settings to change their sell price factor, crafting skill requirement, and more. The draw size for the bot and station graphics can also be changed. This is available for versions 1.3-1.6. Notice: Caching from Rocketman can make any changed settings unresponsive after multiple restarts. Clearing it by changing your mod load list in some way should fix it.
